Commit title: hack warnings: introduce mechanism to silence warnings in generated files
Commit body:
Summary:
This diff:
* introduces config flag `warnings_generated_files`, intended to store regexps of paths of generated files.
  - this flag is wired down to error filtering so that warnings from these files are discarded.
* introduces CLI option `-Wgenerated` to ignore flag `warnings_generated_files` and show warnings from generated files.
